name: Georg Cantor
biography: Credited with developing the precise mathematical theory of continuity and infinite number, resolving the ancient puzzle of infinite collections (illustrated by the one-to-one correspondence between whole numbers and even numbers) and rendering earlier metaphysical uses of 'continuity,' including Bergson's, obsolete.
